meta_description:
858 likes, 19 comments - lonelyplanet on October 28, 2026: "Derry in Northern Ireland goes all out for Halloween, and for good reason. “There's lots of history to absorb here,” says Lonely Planet contributor Ester Pyykkö of this city that “compellingly blends the past and modernity.” You’ll want to join the fun at what Derry calls the biggest Halloween festival in Europe, of course, but save time to walk the city walls, visit the Museum of Free Derry and enjoy a trad music session at a pub, too. Link in bio for all your Derry must-dos 🔗

📸: @biantunesl".
